method: Application scope, not an official occupation classification. No fixed role-count allowlist. Require current O*NET references and a role-specific skill with an actual public catalogue course. Exclude clinical, professional signoff, research-scientist crosswalks and supervised physical trades. Desk-based HR, training, project, supply-chain and language directions are eligible when relevant course coverage exists; prior qualifications, experience and employer requirements still apply. Narrow app career directions share the referenced broad SOC occupation; statistics are not separate estimates for each specialisation.

excluded.AI / Machine Learning Engineer: The current SOC 15-1221 crosswalk describes computer research scientists, not an online-only AI application pathway.
excluded.Accountant: Professional accounting/audit/tax signoff requires credentials beyond this catalogue.
excluded.Financial Analyst: Formal/regulated financial practice is outside this online learning prototype.
excluded.Electrical Engineer: Formal engineering education and supervised professional practice.
excluded.Mechanical Engineer: Formal engineering education and supervised professional practice.
excluded.Electrical and Electronics Technician: Practical equipment training and supervised work.
excluded.Industrial Maintenance Technician: Physical maintenance and supervised safety training.
excluded.Production Operator: Practical equipment operation and workplace safety training.
excluded.Quality Control Inspector: On-site inspection competence and equipment practice.
excluded.Solar PV Installer: Site installation, electrical safety and supervised practical training; not assumed to require a degree in every jurisdiction.
excluded.Registered Nurse: Clinical education, supervised placements and professional registration.
excluded.Medical Records and Health Information S: Specialised healthcare administration and coding requirements beyond this catalogue.
excluded.Mechatronics / Automation Engineer: Engineering equipment design and supervised physical practice are outside this online pathway scope.
